svg.text: CIVIL DETAILS / ROAD AND ACCESS STAIR
One explicit civil voxel model / stone-brick base finish / slab metadata 0 bottom, 8 top
CITY-LOCAL NW ORIGIN | +X EAST | +Z SOUTH | CIVIL Y0 = FUTURE WALKABLE SURFACE S
ALL BOUNDS INCLUSIVE / NO WORLD ANCHOR OR SURVEYED Y / CIVIL DESIGN, NOT GAME-TESTED
Access stair longitudinal section / tile-local Z22..47, X15
S is the eventual walkable road surface. Civil Y0 = S. Road surface blocks occupy -1, road/ path base
-2. Gallery roof is -4, leaving one buffer layer at -3.
Five full air blocks high and six wide on straight runs. Two center blocks stay clear for walking.
Junctions are built from the union footprint, so walls do not close the crossing.
Capped branch floor remains -10. Steam Works basement walkable surface would be -7, so its
future building connection needs a separately detailed two-block rise. No direct connection is
Tile-relative reserve X12..19 Z22..47. Three-wide steps at X14..16, Z42 down to Z25; 18 half-steps rise
from walkable -9 to 0. North landing joins the west road. Open well, side curbs and south stop are
All civil full blocks currently map to minecraft:stonebrick:0. s/ S are stone_slab meta0/ meta8. Role
counts and stock are separate; top slabs use ordinary slab items. No raw ingredient costs are
Hinged covers, railings, lighting and game collision are not certified. No tile entities, multipart
blocks, doors or machine assemblies are included.
